title: Attendance Management System
description: This web portal is developed for OM Engineering College to digitally manage student attendance across various departments. It simplifies and streamlines the process for faculty to mark, track, and analyze student attendance while giving students and administrators real-time visibility and reporting.
fullDescription: The OM Education Attendance Management System is a centralized digital platform designed to automate and manage the daily attendance activities of students and faculty. Developed to enhance operational efficiency and reduce manual errors, the system allows faculty members to log in, record attendance, view reports, and monitor student participation across all departments. It ensures transparency by offering real-time access to attendance data for both academic staff and administrative teams.

With a secure login system and department-wise segregation, the platform provides role-based access to faculty and admins. Key features include date-wise attendance entry, analytics dashboards, monthly reports, student-wise filtering, and downloadable summaries. The portal is mobile-friendly, ensuring accessibility anytime, anywhere. It supports a disciplined academic environment while encouraging student accountability and improved institutional record-keeping.
